takeaways.text: **Pick months on the Backfill month map**: On the Backfill page, click a month, shift-click for a range, or use Select months (Missing, Last 3, Last 12, All), then press Start backfill to queue them, or use Remove from queue and Clear queue to take them back out.

**Pause and Resume for backfill**: In the Backfills widget on the Backfill page, Pause stops all copying, including the 6-hourly scheduled sync, until you press Resume, and the Sync card shows Paused in the meantime.

**Faster backfill copying**: When you backfill Gmail mail, each queued month now copies in its own parallel lane, fetching every message once in full and writing it to storage in packs of up to 50, aiming for about 1,500 messages a minute on Workers Free.
**Account limits by project**: On the Usage and Backfill pages, the Account limits card now has an All / MailCellar toggle, a Refresh button, and new bars for storage, Workflows and CPU per request.

**Backfill buttons work while paused and respond at once**: On the Backfill page, Retry, Start backfill and Clear queue now work while paused, and Clear queue, Stop and Remove show their result immediately instead of after a reload.

**Account limits show who uses them and when they reset**: On the Backfill and Cloudflare usage pages, the Account limits card shows each Cloudflare limit stacked by project, says when daily and monthly limits reset, and pauses backfills at 90% of a free-plan daily cap.

**Copy speed and time left**: On the Backfill page, the Sync card has a new Rate tile (messages copied a minute over the last 10 minutes) and a Queued to copy tile (messages left in queued months, with time left at the current rate).

**Stopped backfills restart on their own**: On the Backfill page, a sync that Cloudflare stopped no longer sits on Running for 45 minutes, because opening the page, Sync now and the schedule all restart it.
**Lighter month coverage map**: The month coverage map on the Backfill page now reads each month's state in one pass, so its 15-second refresh no longer reads about 70,000 database rows per call.
**Clearer month map**: In the month coverage map, for one mailbox or All mailboxes, each year shows copied / Gmail total, and a month taken out of the queue reads Missing instead of Canceled.

**Backfill by month**: On the Backfill page, a coverage map shows each month's Gmail count against what MailCellar has, and you can click months or choose a preset (Missing, Last 3 months, Last 12 months, All) to copy them, newest first, then Cancel or Retry from the jobs list.

**One sidebar section per Gmail account**: In the sidebar, each connected Gmail account has its own foldable section headed by its address, holding that account's Overview, Messages, Senders, Domains, Labels, Time and Gmail settings pages.

**Gmail accounts and Access login**: In Settings ▸ Accounts, you can connect any number of Gmail accounts, use Test to check Read and Modify access, and use Remove to disconnect one and revoke its Google token, while sign-in itself now goes only through Cloudflare Access.

**Scheduled Gmail sync and Sync now**: On the Backfill page, each account's card shows its sync status and progress with a Sync now button, Schedules ▸ Gmail sync ▸ Run now syncs every account, and syncing also runs on the schedule you set.

**Every copied message is stored in Basin**: Every message copied from Gmail now also gets a row in your own Basin table, which is the archive's system of record, so this affects archive storage and has no screen of its own.
**Archive pages read your real mailbox**: On the Overview, Messages, Time, Labels, Domains and Senders pages, you now see counts and lists from your own mailbox, and "No mail yet" until mail arrives.
**Search all mail**: On the Messages page, the "Search all mail" box now searches subject, sender, snippet and labels across your whole mailbox, not just the newest 1,000 messages.
**Saved schedules**: In Settings ▸ Schedules, you can change when Gmail sync and Archive maintenance should run, and your changes are saved in your mailbox (nothing runs on them yet).
**Self-measured Cloudflare usage**: On the Usage page, you can see today's rows written, rows read and messages indexed against the free tier's daily limits.
**Made-up data removed**: In Accounts, Backfill and What's new, the invented accounts, progress and change log are gone, so you see "none connected yet", "Not started" and nothing invented.
